 12th-Ranked Wildcats Travel to Auburn
 Arizona Athletics
 11/12/2026
 No. 12 Arizona men's basketball is back on the road Friday night, traveling to Auburn, Ala., to take on the Tigers in Neville Arena and the nation's longest non-conference home winning streak of 69 games. 
 Tip-off is scheduled for 7:00 p.m. MST on ESPN2, with Rich Hollenberg and Fran Fraschilla on the call. Fans can listen to Brody Dryden and Ryan Hansen will have the radio call via Wildcats Radio 1290AM. 
 For more news and notes on the game, continue below.
 Watch on ESPN+ Listen on Wildcats Radio 1290 Live Stats Arizona Game Notes Arizona Notes & Numbers 
 > Tuesday’s win over Northern Arizona was the 150th for head coach Tommy Lloyd. He ranks in the top 10 in NCAA history for fastest to the mark, needing 187 games.
 > Arizona is 37-17 in true road games under Lloyd. The .685 winning percentage is the fifth-best in the country since the start of the 2021-22 season.
 > The Wildcats average 81.0 points per game in true road games under Lloyd, the third-most of any team in the country (Gonzaga - 84.8; Alabama - 84.3).
 > After Ivan Kharchenkov dropped a career-high 38 points in the season opener against UCLA, Motiejus Krivas scored a career-high 30 points against Cal Poly. Arizona and USC are the only teams in the country to have two different players score 30 in a game.
 > The last time Arizona had two different players score 30 or more points in back to back games was Khalid Reeves and Damon Stoudamire during the 1993-94 season.
 > Kharchenkov leads the Wildcats in points, rebounds and assists through the first three games.
 > The Wildcats registered 26 assists on 37 made field goals against Northern Arizona. It was the 16th time under Lloyd that Arizona has had 26 or more assists, which is the second-most in the country (Cornell - 19 times).
 > Since the start of the 2021-22 season, Arizona leads the country in assists (3,351).
 > Freshman sensation Caleb Holt is averaging 15.0 points and 6.7 rebounds while shooting 51.4% from the floor. He is one of eight true freshmen in the country posting those marks so far this season.
 > JJ Mandaquit has 15 assists and just one turnover through three games, tied for the fourth-best assist-to-turnover ratio in the country.
 > Derek Dixon scored a career-high 18 points in his Arizona debut against UCLA and is averaging 13.0 points per game.

 LEARN ABOUT LLOYD 
 Arizona head coach Tommy Lloyd is in his sixth season as the head coach at Arizona and has a record of 150-37 (.802). It’s the second-best winning percentage among active D-1 head coaches that are in at least their fifth season at the Division I level (Mark Few - Gonzaga).
 Under Lloyd, Arizona is 35-17 against Top 25 opponents, the best winning percentage in the country. Arizona’s 14-2 (.875) record vs. ranked teams last season were the most by any team in the country.
 Lloyd was named 2026 Naismith National Coach of the Year, The Sporting News National Coach of the Year and Big 12 Coach of the Year. He was named AP Coach of the Year in 2022, making him the fourth coach to be named national coach of the year twice in his first five seasons (Fred Taylor - Ohio State, Tom Izzo - Michigan State, Roy Williams - Kansas).
 After sweeping the Big 12 regular season championship and tournament titles, Arizona has won six conference championships - regular season and tournament - in five seasons under Lloyd. (2022, 2024, 2026 seasons; 2022, 2023, 2026 tournaments).
 IVAN THE GREAT VS. UCLA 
 Sophomore Ivan Kharchenkov had one of the most prolific games in program history, finishing with 38 points and 10 rebounds against UCLA. The list of Wildcats to reach those numbers in a game prior to Kharchenkov include:
 - Al Fleming vs. Detroit (Jan. 10, 1976 - 41 points, 11 rebs) 
 - Bob Elliott vs. Utah (Feb. 15, 1975 - 39 points, 12 rebs) 
 - Bob Elliott vs. Cal (Dec. 27, 1974 - 38 points, 11 rebs) 
 - Al Fleming vs. SDSU (Dec. 7, 1974 - 39 points, 17 rebs) 
 - Bob Elliott vs. Arizona St. (Feb. 2, 1974 - 38 points, 25 rebs) 
 - Coniel Norman vs. BYU (Feb. 24, 1973 - 38 points, 10 rebs) 
 Kharchenkov became the second DI player in the last 30 years to have at least 35 points and 10 rebounds against an AP Top 25 team in a season opener. The other was Tennessee-Martin’s Lester Hudson at No. 3 Memphis to start 2007-08 (35, 10).
